title: Cook’s membrane: finite-strain nearly incompressible neo-Hookean, prescribed hybrid hex8 meshes
source: C. D. Foster and T. Mohammad Nejad, Trilinear Hexahedra with Integral-Averaged Volumes for Nearly Incompressible Nonlinear Deformation, Engineering 7:765–788 (2015), DOI 10.4236/eng.2015.711067, https://content.scirp.org/pdf/eng_2015113016463684.pdf: pp. 773 Eqs. (57)–(59), 775 §5.2, 778 Fig. 8 and Table 4 (authors’ J averaged in reference configuration column), 779 Fig. 9. Plane strain, thickness 1 mm; μ₀ = 0.8 and K = 4000 N/mm²; total upward dead force 1 N. Each value belongs to its stated regular mapped trilinear mesh, not a continuum limit.

quantities.quantity: vertical displacement of C (48, 60, 0), mm, 4 × 4 × 1 hybrid hex8
quantities.reason: 0.5% is the comparison policy proposed in issue #83 for independent implementations, retained without fitting; it is not the paper’s uncertainty or a rounding bound. Four printed decimal places imply only ±0.00005 mm rounding. This compares the prescribed mesh and reference-volume mean-dilatation formulation; the README separates mesh refinement, our solver sensitivity and the source’s unreported numerical settings.
